title: Analysis of Commercial Semiconductor Devices with Atom Probe Tomography
content: CAMECA has released several innovations in recent years to improve throughput and ease-of-use for atom probe tomography (APT), resulting in improved analysis success rates (yield) and high throughput of semiconducting and insulating materials. The addition of a deep UV laser in the 6000 series atom probes has substantially increased specimen yield for some semiconductor structures in consumer electronic devices. In this study, an analysis of an off-the-shelf ‘Qualcomm Snapdragon® X70’ processor using 4nm node FinFET technology and a ‘Murata ME13J’ barium titanate based Multi-Layer Ceramic Capacitor (MLCC) structure is presented.
